extracted.intended_audience: Hollywood publicists, SAG-AFTRA members, and entertainment industry professionals
extracted.subtask_description: Summarizes SAG-AFTRA's expected member conduct if a strike is called, with specific prohibitions, permitted activities with limits, required disclaimers for pre-strike publicity, and conditions for exceptions for independent productions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No participation in film and television productions
rubrics_metrics.description: Members must step away from all film and television productions worldwide if a strike is called.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an across-the-board prohibition on shooting/production work once the strike is in effect; applies globally to film and TV projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: No promotional work of any kind
rubrics_metrics.description: Actors will not be permitted to take part in promotional work of any kind, including press junkets, film premieres, and fan events like San Diego Comic-Con.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibits traditional publicity activities that promote specific films or shows; includes appearances whose primary purpose is publicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convention attendance allowed only if non-promotional
rubrics_metrics.description: Actors are permitted to attend pop culture conventions as long as they don’t take part in any panels that promote a specific film or television show or discuss any current or future work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While mere attendance is allowed, the union 'would prefer' members completely skip such events. If attending, avoid panels, signings, or talks that function as publicity or discuss current/future projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancel scheduled press or acting work after strike begins
rubrics_metrics.description: Any scheduled press or acting work after a strike is ordered must be cancelled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This applies to work scheduled to occur while the strike is in effect; publicists should proactively cancel and not attempt to proceed with press/acting engagements.

rubrics_metrics.name: No social media promotion of work
rubrics_metrics.description: SAG-AFTRA members are not permitted to promote any work on social media, as that is considered publicity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes posting promotional material, links, endorsements, or otherwise using personal/official social accounts to publicize projects during the strike period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-deadline junkets must carry disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: Studios that held press junkets ahead of the strike deadline are being asked to include a disclaimer that they were recorded beforehand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicists should label pre-deadline promotional recordings as pre-recorded to avoid mischaracterization as strike-period publicity; SAG-AFTRA will monitor and contact those who may be breaching rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent production exceptions with interim agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Exceptions may be given to independent productions that agree to terms with SAG-AFTRA on an interim basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such productions must be 'truly independent,' meaning no studio or streamer that is a member of the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP) may be attached as producer or distributor. Interim deals require explicit agreement with the union.

rubrics_metrics.name: Union enforcement and monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: SAG-AFTRA will be reaching out to those who are possibly breaching these rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicists and members should expect the union to monitor compliance and contact individuals or companies it believes are violating strike rules; this is part of enforcement and oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing distinction: pre-deadline vs post-strike
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities occurring before the strike deadline may be treated differently (e.g., pre-deadline junkets), whereas any work after a strike is ordered must be cancelled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicists should document timing of recordings/events and use disclaimers where appropriate; be cautious about apparent attempts to circumvent the rules by presenting post-strike publicity as pre-strike.
